name: SK hynix

source.quote: announced today that it has achieved record financial results in 2025 – 97.1467 trillion won in revenue, 47.2063 trillion won in operating profit (with an operating margin of 49%), and 42.9479 trillion won in net profit (with a net margin of 44%).

description: South Korean memory maker and the largest supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI chips.
explain: SK hynix makes most of the HBM memory that sits next to Nvidia's AI chips, which made it one of the biggest winners of the AI build-out. Revenue converted from 97.15 trillion won at roughly 1,420 won per dollar (2025 average).
